settings.hero_alt: I want all eight. All eight Evolution Companions plushes in a styled campaign scene.
settings.hero_title: You don’t have to pick a favorite.
settings.hero_body: Bring home all eight plush companions together. Every color, every little face, one complete $160 set.
settings.story_title: Picking one was never really the plan.
settings.story_body: Pick up the one you spotted first. Put another beside it. Before you know it, you’re making room for the whole gang.
settings.size_title: Which one gets the spot beside you?
settings.size_body: Put your favorite beside your pillow. Set the others where you’ll see them every day. With all eight at home, you can change your mind tomorrow.
settings.proof_title: Which one are you picking up first?
settings.proof_body: Take a closer look at the little brown paws, stitched smiles and colorful hoods. Every one is part of your set.
settings.final_body: You’ve already spotted your favorites. The complete set means none of them has to stay behind.
settings.point_1_body: The one you noticed first gets the best spot. The others won’t be far away.
settings.point_2_body: Line them all up and enjoy seeing the whole collection together.
settings.point_3_body: Keep the whole gang together or give each one a spot around your room.
